proof_scope: the runner's own fail-closed gate, outcome taxonomy, artifact assertions, and process-group teardown (issue #1430)

claims.proves: that run exits non-zero unless required cases are READY, that --report-only opts out, that BLOCKED never reaches READY, that cross-artifact equality is asserted without stdout parsing, that a timed-out case leaves no child process, and that manifest proof scope/claims survive into the report
claims.does_not_prove: anything about any evaluated skill; these cases exercise the runner itself

cases.name: a-failed-required-case-makes-run-exit-non-zero
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"f","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","exit 3"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/f.json"; $R run "$D/f.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0 && echo GATE_FAILS_CLOSED

cases.name: report-only-exits-zero-on-the-same-manifest
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"f","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","exit 3"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/f.json"; $R run "$D/f.json" --report-only >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 0 && echo REPORT_ONLY_EXITS_ZERO

cases.name: a-timed-out-case-leaves-no-child-process
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"t","type":"adversarial","timeout_seconds":3,"command":["bash","-c","sleep 300 & sleep 300"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/t.json"; $R run "$D/t.json" --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d[\"cases\"][0][\"trials\"][0];assert t[\"timed_out\"], t;assert t[\"orphan_pids_after_teardown\"]==[], t;print(\"NO_ORPHANS_AFTER_TIMEOUT\")"

cases.name: a-required-blocked-case-does-not-reach-ready
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"b","type":"positive","blocked_when_stdout_contains":["NO_CREDENTIAL"],"command":["bash","-c","echo NO_CREDENTIAL"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/b.json"; $R run "$D/b.json" --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert d[\"readiness\"]!=\"READY\", d[\"readiness\"];assert d[\"cases\"][0][\"outcome\"]==\"BLOCKED\", d;print(\"BLOCKED_DOES_NOT_REACH_READY\")"

cases.name: cross-artifact-equality-is-asserted-without-stdout
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"sessionId":"S-1"}' > "$D/a.json"; printf '{"sessionId":"S-1"}' > "$D/ok.json"; printf '{"sessionId":"S-2"}' > "$D/bad.json"; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","cases":[{"name":"m","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","true"],"expected":{"exit_code":0,"artifacts":[{"path":"a.json","json_pointer":"/sessionId","equals_artifact":{"path":"ok.json","json_pointer":"/sessionId"}}]}},{"name":"x","type":"adversarial","command":["bash","-c","true"],"expected":{"exit_code":0,"artifacts":[{"path":"a.json","json_pointer":"/sessionId","equals_artifact":{"path":"bad.json","json_pointer":"/sessionId"}}]}}]}' > "$D/x.json"; $R run "$D/x.json" --report-only 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);o=[c[\"outcome\"] for c in d[\"cases\"]];assert o==[\"PASS\",\"FAIL\"], o;print(\"CROSS_ARTIFACT_ASSERTED\")"

cases.name: the-report-preserves-the-manifest-proof-scope
command: D=$(mktemp -d) && R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; pwd)"; R=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/agentic-evals/run.sh; printf '{"version":2,"skill":"s","trials":1,"eval_kind":"runner_selftest","proof_scope":"SCOPE-SENTINEL","claims":{"proves":"P-SENTINEL","does_not_prove":"n"},"cases":[{"name":"p","type":"positive","command":["bash","-c","true"],"expected":{"exit_code":0}}]}' > "$D/p.json"; $R run "$D/p.json" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert d[\"proof_scope\"]==\"SCOPE-SENTINEL\", d[\"proof_scope\"];assert d[\"claims\"][\"proves\"]==\"P-SENTINEL\", d[\"claims\"];print(\"MANIFEST_CLAIMS_PRESERVED\")"
